description: GPT-3.5 Turbo is OpenAI's fast and cost-effective model for simpler tasks. It's optimized for chat and traditional completions tasks, offering good performance at low cost.

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse mixture of licensed data, data created by human trainers, and publicly available data.

trainingProcedure: Trained using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). Optimized for chat-style interactions.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Provides good performance for everyday tasks at a fraction of the cost of GPT-4. Suitable for most applications that don't require advanced reasoning.

knownLimitations: Less capable than GPT-4 on complex reasoning tasks
May generate incorrect or misleading information
Can exhibit biases present in training data
Limited mathematical reasoning compared to GPT-4

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: OpenAI has implemented safety mitigations but the model may still exhibit biases.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built-in content filtering and RLHF training to refuse harmful requests.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Data sent to the API may be used to improve the model unless opted out.
